evidence.why: Arbitrary URL taken directly from incoming link query parameter with no host allowlist or scheme check.
Unvalidated attacker-controlled URL is passed straight to the WebView-loading flow.

WebView loads a URL that originated from the deep link without requiring https or checking host against an allowlist; attacker also controls headers and WebView settings (JS, file access) via link params.
http/https data element declared without android:autoVerify="true", so App Link verification is not enforced.

other_classes_observed: Attacker-controlled WebView settings (JS enabled, file access, universal access from file URLs) toggled via link parameters
Attacker-controlled HTTP headers injected into loadUrl via link parameter
